maddeler.e:
أقتدي (form VIII)
# أَقْتَدِي (ʔaqtadī) /ʔaq.ta.diː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَدَى (iqtadā)
# أَقْتَدِيَ (ʔaqtadiya) /ʔaq.ta.di.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَدَى (iqtadā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
